correctness.rationale: PASS: Acyclic orientations of a book are precisely the two selector-conditioned products of three legal patterns per page: common edge prevents directed triangles and any directed four-cycle would force one forbidden mixed page. Exact four-query-type recurrence closes on F(u,a,c)=max(u+a,u+c,1+floor((3u+a+c)/2)); the u=0 base and u>0 induction handle every parity/edge case. Forest VC dimension is b+1 for b>=0. Independently generated all orientations and solved full minimax recurrence for b=0..4, obtaining 1,2,4,5,7. Finite cases corroborate, not substitute for the induction.
